svg.title: two cats system overview: the iPhone's SQLite ledger is the source of truth; a Go server on Render stores sync envelopes in PlanetScale Postgres, proxies receipts to Azure Document Intelligence, keeps photos in Cloudflare R2 and backs up nightly to Backblaze B2.

svg.text: SQLite ledger, read and written by GRDB
the source of truth: every screen observes it
one envelope per change, drained in the background
Your other iPhone, or a friend's
Pulls the same envelopes and replays
them into its own SQLite ledger.
Go, one small binary on Render
checks who may push to whom,
the key stays on the server
Envelopes travel in both directions. A friend's phone, once shared ledgers open, pulls the envelopes addressed to it and replays them locally.
